question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Combine runs and wickets per bowler, calculate bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, 
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er 
      ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
      ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT br.bowler, p.player_name, br.total_runs, bw.wickets,
       ROUND(1.0 * br.total_runs / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_avg
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 10
